d:
Mokama ke charchit bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ne 1 disanbar tak sarendar karne ke aadesh, jadyu se nishkasan, vidhanasbha sadasyata radd karne ke notis aur sarkari aavas khali karne ke aadesh par apni chuppi tori hai.
Anant sinh ne kaha ki 25 navanbar ko unki beti ki shadi hai aur shadi sanpann hone ke bad yadi jel jana para to ve saharsh jel chale jaenge. dularchand hatyakand par apni saphaee dete hue unhonne kaha ki ghatna ke samay ve mauke se 5 kilomitar dur ganv men khana kha rahe the aur apne kainpen men the, unhen sajish ke tahat phansaya gaya hai.
